subject: Energy
title: Earth's Energy Budget
description: A quick win: understand Earth's Energy Budget.

hook.text: Earth constantly balances incoming solar energy with outgoing radiation—this energy budget sets our climate.

buildup.text: About 30% of incoming sunlight is reflected straight back to space by clouds, ice, and bright surfaces.

discovery.text: The remaining 70% is absorbed by land, oceans, and atmosphere—then re-emitted as infrared radiation.

twist.text: Greenhouse gases trap outgoing infrared—raising Earth's surface temperature about 33°C above what it'd otherwise be.

climax.text: Adding more CO₂ tips the balance—Earth absorbs more energy than it radiates, and the planet slowly warms.

punchline.text: A tiny imbalance in the budget—and the whole climate shifts.
